protocol.hypothesis: Public context plus previous-opponent cue supports six learnable mappings with early no-message headroom.
protocol.task: context 0 uses opponent offset +1; context 1 uses offset +2; context is not a rule label.
protocol.inputs: context 0: first two VPNs in lane 0; context 1: first two VPNs in lane 1; move cue: existing laneVpn[cue].slice(2); both at 150 Hz, 0-240 ms.
protocol.schedule: one cue-free warmup, then 18 observed rounds in six fixed three-round context blocks alternating 0/1; each context-move cell appears three times per episode.
protocol.learner: eight opt-in three-action heads (six context-move plus two context-specific cue-free); original MBON features, alpha .03, epsilon .20, selected-action own-reward update; no teacher/message.
protocol.training: 12 episodes x 18 observed rounds, checkpoints 0/1/3/12 episodes
protocol.evaluation: three fixed 73-round sequences per checkpoint; one warmup plus 72 scored rounds, 12 per context-move cell per sequence; greedy, disconnected, no learning.
protocol.streams: network rng(key+2), action rng(key+501), key=studentSeed*10000000+episodeKey*1000+round; separate deterministic opponent seeds.

gates.route: exact context and move routing on every input; no ties; cue-free only on warmup
gates.trainingCoverage: exactly 3 trials per context-move cell per episode
gates.heldOutCoverage: 36 trials per context-move cell across three evaluation sequences
gates.earlyHeadroom: each seed mean expected-optimal accuracy <=75% after 1 episode
gates.eventualLearnability: each seed >=9/12 expected-optimal choices in every cell after 12 episodes
gates.integrity: unchanged KC-to-MBON multipliers; frozen Q weights; exact selected-head update only

protocol.seedAudit: 951-953 absent from saved JSON seed fields, research docs, and experiment scripts; 901-903 were excluded as previously used.
